items.heading: Most of the Weight
items.text: Most of the weight you feel comes from treating three different decisions as one. Only the first one is due now.

items.heading: Confusion Has Different Causes,
items.text: Confusion has different causes, and each one needs a different first move. OECD's 2020 Dream Jobs? report found that teenagers' job hopes cluster around a small set of familiar jobs, so seeing more kinds of work is often the real fix.

items.heading: Compare Routes By Their Doors,
items.text: Compare routes by their doors, not by their prestige. Rules differ by board, state and school, so confirm each point on the official page before you pay.
